fatal_blockers: Proposal 1 does not specify an integral CVP tile: the boundary lifts, selector columns, targets, maximal-order basis, cocycle-to-prime map, rank, and finite search domain are absent. An ordinary linear selector row cannot enforce the nonlinear Heisenberg composition law, so the claimed escape from G13 and the current false-111 splice is unproved.

Proposal 2 assumes that reversing legal COPY induces inverse endomorphisms on one adverse defect module. Q2 neither supplies that identification nor requires reverse adverse transfers to compose to identity; the elementary contradiction is valid only under an unsupported premise and therefore does not constrain the frontier.

Proposal 3 assigns path words through a nonlinear history operation without showing how unrestricted integral selectors emit exactly one such history in an ordinary lattice. Linearizing it as flow or transition selectors reopens G19 signed splicing, while the depth-two shell, weights, radius, and exact lattice are unspecified.

Proposal 4 confuses polynomial scheme certificates with linear CVP soundness. Moreover, a forbidden idempotent equal to one at an adverse Boolean point cannot equal a uniformizer multiple modulo a saturated ideal there, since reduction modulo P gives 1=0; excluding that point would merely remove the adverse state rather than prove Q2.

Proposal 5 only detects nonzero syndrome streams, but the verified false-111 NAND fiber and bidirectional COPY splice have zero leading syndrome. No enlarged syndrome map is supplied that escapes the honest-affine-span collision, and the Toeplitz matrix dimensions and lifted interface are not fixed.

Proposal 6 proves path lifting only for honest walks, whereas CVP coefficients form signed integral chains. Nonabelian deck multiplication is not enforced by incidence rows, so G19/diagonal splices can have legal boundary and trivial linear residue without representing any path; the proposed cover and ILP encoding are also not serialized.

None of the six experiments is a fully specified bounded test of ROADMAP's Q1/COPY and Q2 frontier. Several could test conditional algebraic statements, but no pass would establish even a finite transition table for an emitted NAND/COPY lattice.
evidence: The current NAND verifier certifies exact grade-zero false fibers 010, 100, and 111 at energies 64, 56, and 56. The COPY verifier exhausts 378 declared affine codes and finds a zero-residual false111-COPY11-false111 splice in both orientations.

The existing Lean theorem proves only that supplied local potential inequalities telescope and that one gain per four levels beats binary scaling at 17. No proposal supplies the required complete transition relation, lift independence, potential, or local inequalities.

G13 already shows that compatible affine rows vanish on the honest-affine-span pseudosection, while G19 and Goal G1 show that path/flow and diagonal coherence do not control signed integral combinations. Proposals 1, 3, 5, and 6 do not provide a concrete nonlinear emitted mechanism escaping those attacks.

G28, G30, and G37 show that finite separation, tagging, or coding does not imply strict recursive growth. No proposed experiment computes a complete legal/adverse recurrence with lambda greater than mu.
All existing positive bag, Walsh, and redundant-NAND results are explicitly finite-only. They provide no evidence for the all-depth claims made here.

fatal_blockers: Proposals 1–4 and 6 never serialize the required enlarged integral NAND/COPY tile: no complete selector set, maximal-order matrices, targets, legal fibers, glue equations, or proof that the added coordinate breaks s111=-s001+s011+s101. Consequently their claims to escape G13, Goal G11–12, and the current 111 splice are assumptions rather than mechanisms.

Proposal 1 tests only an unspecified F17 transition complex, not the required P^2 states and P^3 lifts. A relative cocycle cannot separate an adverse chain that is a relative boundary, and no concrete complex or gluing map establishes the asserted multiplication by a uniformizer.

Proposal 2 is internally defective as written: an exact complex has zero homology, conflicting with its proposed adverse homology H. Even after repairing terminology, projectivity and Nakayama do not force the gluing connecting map to equal multiplication by P, and the rank-at-most-four search omits P^3 carry/lift-independence.

Proposal 3 applies path holonomy to unrestricted integral superpositions, which need not be paths and can cancel edge labels as in G19-type signed splicing. Searching labels against only known splices cannot certify all signed fibers or Q2.

Proposal 4 invokes anisotropy and reduced-norm multiplicativity for individual quaternion points, but the soundness obstruction consists of unrestricted affine combinations of selectors. Its P^2 table search omits P^3 lifts, carries, saturation, and a derivation from table mixtures to a strict norm gain.

Proposal 6 has no demonstrated adverse syndrome seed: the current false-111 pseudosection produces zero affine defect, so a convolutional encoder merely encodes zero unless a concrete enlarged NAND interface first breaks that relation. Column distance of a finite trellis does not by itself establish the claimed four-level valuation transfer under composed signed fibers.

Proposal 5 only formalizes the already-established append-only affine no-go and does not test an enlarged frontier candidate. Proposal 7 applies Artin–Rees to one fixed submodule, while NAND composition produces depth-dependent unions of affine fibers; stabilization for one module gives no uniform all-depth transfer theorem.
evidence: The supplied determinant-one NAND verifier certifies exact zero-residual false fibers 010, 100, and 111 at squared energies 64, 56, and 56. Thus every proposal requiring a pre-existing nonzero adverse defect fails on the current tile.

The COPY verifier exhausts 378 saturated binary-signature affine codes of ranks 2–8 and finds a zero-residual false111–COPY11–false111 splice in both orientations. This kills plain affine gluing but supplies no evidence for any unspecified enlarged state system.

The normalized affine identity s111=-s001+s011+s101 makes every compatible append-only affine row invisible on the frozen selector module. None of Proposals 1–4 or 6 supplies explicit new legal variables and equations that invalidate this identity.

The compiled Lean result proves only that a supplied local potential certificate telescopes and that one gain per four levels beats base two at 17. No proposal provides the complete transition relation, lift-independence proof, bounded potential, or local inequalities needed to instantiate it.

ROADMAP requires one fixed augmented integral coupling followed by exhaustive normalized P^2/P^3 testing of both orientations, DROP, malformed boundaries, carries, and internal zero-boundary kernels. None of the seven proposed experiments satisfies that gate, and finite passes could not be promoted to Q2 in any event.
